attention_backend: Pinned TeleOCR/vLLM native capability selection; no forced VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND. The vision head dimension is 80, unsupported by the installed vLLM FlashAttention kernel.

native.prompts_and_sampling: Unmodified pinned TeleOCR defaults, verified in every worker receipt.

regions.rotation: No additional rotation for regional rereads.
regions.crop: Captured native-rendered pixels only; map middle coordinates using captured image dimensions / integer native page_size
regions.resize: Python round, minimum one pixel, Pillow LANCZOS.
regions.validation: Reference runaway rules; lxml is mandatory. Empty text blocks are not guard eligible.
regions.rejection: One reread only; retain native on invalid output. No guard retries.
regions.history: Separate audit events, never nested into inference geometry.

limits.smoke_reuse: 16 fixed SHA256-selected technical pages contribute unchanged outputs to1651; remaining1635 run once

failure_policy.page_timeout: Abort this page's vLLM request IDs. Keep the last atomically completed stage; empty when native output was not completed. Never rerun a completed or failed page.
failure_policy.regional_exception: Record the exception; retain the last completed stage and stop this page's remaining interventions.
failure_policy.hard_timeout: Supervisor kills only the owned container at 600 seconds; recover the last completed stage. An engine/container replacement consumes the arm's sole infrastructure restart.
failure_policy.systemic_defect: Stop affected owned jobs and distinguish a repaired run; never edit an active frozen run.

status: Four direct-scale controllers fitted; external actors and shared benchmark protocol frozen before evaluation
comparison_scope: Diagnostic paired outputs sharing one native parse and identical per-region actions; not independent fresh runs

adaptive.input_features: 17 native-region features; no candidate log-scale input

gate.rule: reread once for finite features and feasible projected dimensions; retain native on invalid reread; no quality gate or threshold tuning

target.source: best valid measured reread among at most 8 distinct realized offline views

external.source_group_split: Published-source documents grouped before inference; preserved128-pilot roles; later groups assigned by frozen source hash; actual159/42/41 groups
external.source_coverage: Public scientific-paper source pages; no claim of general multilingual, scanned or financial coverage
external.source_size_limitation: Audited formula release300 validation examples/159documents plus reliable source/native correspondence reduced the pool; approved smaller reliable pool
